name: ask-your-audience
description: Ask Human Digital Twins, built from real people, what they think of your ideas, messages and ads. Start with a free Snapshot, then run a full study: you see the brief and the AYA tokens it uses first, and nothing runs until you approve.

interface.longDescription: Before you make the decision, Ask Your Audience. Help product, marketing and research teams explore concepts, messaging and supplied creative with audience-matched digital twins. Get a free Snapshot: six matched twins react to an idea in about a minute, with no audience or tokens needed. Connect your existing AYA account to find or suggest an audience, then prepare a Concept Test, Image Ad Evaluator, Focus Group, Interview, follow-up or Brand Evaluator. Review the exact brief, participants and the AYA tokens a study uses from your existing plan before explicitly approving a run. Discuss returned findings and evidence in chat, compare a follow-up with the original twin by twin, or open an AYA visual when useful. Digital twin responses are simulated qualitative research, not a representative survey or a prediction of real-world outcomes. Saved study access depends on separately approved permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me a free Snapshot: what would people in the UK think of a reusable coffee cup with a refundable deposit?
Prepare a Concept Test for this proposition with an audience in my AYA account.
Help me understand the findings from my completed AYA study.
